LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MechanoidBloodline.label: [Raven] Mechanoid Bloodline
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MechanoidBloodline.descript:
A cold bloodline derived from mechanoids. The cellular structure is infused with nanomachines and synthetic materials, rendering the skin as hard as iron and completely fireproof.

Effects:
- Flammability forced to 0%
- Sharp armor +20%
- Blunt armor +10%
- Grants resistance to toxins and heat.
